name: database
description: Application database with schema-driven CRUD, type generation, OBO, and RLS

required.description: Lakebase Postgres instance for application data. Schema lives at config/database/schema.ts.

branch.description: Full Lakebase Postgres branch resource name.

database.description: Full Lakebase Postgres database resource name.

databaseName.description: Postgres database name for local development.

tolerateSetupFailure.description: If true, plugin boot continues when schema-load OR drift introspection fails. Off by default (fail closed in production).

statementTimeoutMs.description: Server-side `statement_timeout` (ms) applied per pool connection. Defaults to 15_000.

healthCheck.description: Set false to suppress the `GET /api/database/_healthz` route.

entitiesDiscovery.description: Set false to suppress the `GET /api/database/_entities` discovery route.

oboPoolMax.description: Maximum number of per-user OBO pools to keep open. Worst-case fan-out is (1 + oboPoolMax) × OBO_POOL_DEFAULTS.max + POOL_DEFAULTS.max connections per app instance.

onSetupMessage:
Database plugin installed. Next: npx appkit db init
  - For a new database: define entities in config/database/schema.ts (and optional demo rows in config/database/seed.sql) before running init.
  - For an existing Lakebase: just run init; it will introspect the schema for you.
The init command picks the Databricks profile and Lakebase project, creates a per-user dev branch, writes .env, and runs the right setup or introspection.
